dreamteamer.title: HTML pages
dreamteamer.description: A page on a record. The `html-page` mixin gives a collection one field, `page`: static HTML of 204,800 characters at most, which the desktop app draws in a sandboxed frame where no script runs and nothing is loaded. The package also exports `htmlToText`, a page as the text a reader gets from it.
